newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy to issue 9.25 trln lire Btps/Ccts.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy to issue 9.25 trln lire Btps/Ccts.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected to issue 8.5 to 10 trillion lire of fixed-rate government bonds (Btps) and floating-rate certificates (Ccts) at its mid-month auction, analysts polled by Reuters said on Friday.
They expect an average 9.25 trillion lire of medium and long term paper will be issued at the auctions on May 15 and 16.
The Treasury said on Thursday it will issue a third tranche of May 1, 2004 Ccts and a 15th tranche of February 1, 2007 Btps on May 15.
On May 16, the Treasury will issue a new three-year Btp maturing on May 15, 2000, bearing a six percent coupon together with the 11th tranche of a March 1, 2002 Btp bearing a 6.25-percent coupon.
The Treasury details the actual amounts on offer on May 12.
Some 1.5 trillion lire of Ecu-denominated certificates (Cte) and around one trillion lire of coupons mature in the middle of the month.
